data.desc: Datavault AI Inc. (Nasdaq: DVLT) is an AIP company focused on transforming data and real-world assets into intelligent, secure and monetizable digital assets. The Company's integrated platform combines artificial intelligence, an AI-driven inference layer, data valuation, tokenization, cybersecurity, high-performance computing and exchange technologies to support the lifecycle of data and digital assets-from identification and valuation through tokenization, commercialization and monetization. Datavault AI operates through two synergistic divisions: Data Science and Acoustic Science. The Data Science division includes the Company's patented Data Vault, DataValue and DataScore technologies, together with its cybersecurity, tokenization and exchange capabilities. The Acoustic Science division includes WiSA, ADIO and related spatial audio and data-over-sound technologies, as well as the Company's events and experiential media businesses, including CompuSystems, Inc.
